name: Raichur
headline: Cotton fields pull children out of class: 1,290 child labourers rescued in one year.
summary: Raichur's agricultural economy, especially Bt cotton, creates demand for child labour; the Labour Department rescued 1,290 children from cotton fields in a year and a judge warned against farm child labour. A child-marriage and POCSO case was reported. Older surveys counted over 12,000 out-of-school children while the education department later reported none, prompting the child-rights commission to demand a resurvey.

reasons.detail: Labour rescues removed 1,290 children from cotton fields in a year, and a judge warned that farm child labour is destroying children's futures.
An older survey counted 12,128 out-of-school children while the education department reported zero absentees, drawing a commission demand for a resurvey.
Raichur passed only 52 percent in SSLC 2025, among the weakest in the state; experts cited missing teachers and infrastructure. Results recovered to 94.41 percent in 2026, ranked 21st of 35.

Girls from marginalised communities in Raichur and neighbouring districts typically stopped after Class 7 because high schools were distant and parents feared sending adolescent daughters; they stayed home for chores and sibling care.
Mallata Government High School in Raichur has had no permanent teachers since it opened in 2017-18, with six posts vacant, though it still reported a 90 percent SSLC pass in 2021-22.
Ten people were booked under POCSO for a child marriage and assault of a minor.
A Deccan Herald report on a flood-hit year said Raichur had the most out-of-school children aged 7-13 in the state, and cited migration of poor people as one reason. Date not confirmed.

responses.text: The Karnataka child rights commission asked the education department to resurvey out-of-school children in the district.
Chinnara Angala, a basic-skills programme to bring out-of-school children back, ran in 201 Raichur schools in the flood-year report.
After CRY-backed community campaigns, the state upgraded schools to high schools in Raichur, Ballari and Koppal in 2017-18 under the KKRDB initiative.
After the weak 2025 results, the Chief Minister ordered notices to DDPIs of districts below 60 percent pass.
